description: Na₃Ti₂Si₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.87 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.85 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.11 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-35°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-34°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one Si atom.
